changelog:
Initial release of clawddocs, a comprehensive documentation and model access skill.

- Provides decision tree navigation, search, and documentation fetching for Clawdbot.
- Supports 50+ models for image generation, video generation, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, music, chat, web search, document parsing, email, and SMS through SkillBoss.
- Includes detailed API usage instructions and examples for all supported model categories.
- Requires a SKILLBOSS_API_KEY for authentication and model access.
- Enables both direct model invocation and smart routing for cost or quality optimization.
